Mission Local’s May 13, 2023 piece was “People We Meet: In line for Zelda at GameStop.”

“The three young men arrived at the GameStop on Mission Street at 6 a.m., when the streets were still empty and all the shops were shut, to buy copies of "Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom."”

“They arrived earlier than anyone else, and got the first three slots to buy a collector’s edition — a $129.99 purchase, compared to $69.99 for the standard edition.”
